Buffalo FX browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Buffalo FX CVIII - BC108 Silicon Fuzz Published on August 20, 2013 Buffalo FX fuzz pedal Information Buffalo FX This is the classic fuzz circuit as used by Hendrix during the Band of Gypsy's era but with some additional features to make it more versatile. The Fuzz control is in a different configuration to the classic allowing control over the whole range without getting too muddy or losing clarity. I've added a shape control which cuts the low end from the signal which is great for big lead tones. Make no mistake, this is the real deal Silicon Fuzz as used by the greats but with a few more options to get you the tones your looking for. 100% Handmade True Bypass Gain selected BC108 Transistors Shape, Fuzz and level controls Top mounted Jacks High quality components, neutrik jacks, vishay /wima caps in signal path, screened cabling for low noise operation.
